guideline: We ask participants to cluster words in t_j,i that they deem similar to form coherent word groups g
Participants were instructed to assign each word to a coherent group (or “Not Related”) using a Likert matrix, clustering words they perceived as semantically coherent.

Users are tasked to cluster words in t_j,i that they deem similar to form coherent word groups g, where their response R_u,j,i to t_j,i is a set of unique g. We constrain each word to only belong to one coherent word group to limit the task complexity. Additionally, a word considered to be unrelated may form its group of one.
